questions: Only process MLS regular season fixtures for 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. Exclude MLS Cup/playoffs, USL, MLS Next Pro, cups, friendlies and other competitions. Use the local fixture identity as the join key: season + local date + home_team + away_team, and preserve stable_match_key/provider_match_id when available.

For every expected fixture row, return meeting_number: the number of the meeting between the same two teams in that MLS regular season. Prefer a direct official or schedule field. If it is derived only from a complete source schedule, label field_semantics=derived_from_complete_source_schedule and include derivation_rule, source_schedule_url and the ordered source rows; do not infer from a partial list or from odds/results alone.

For every expected fixture row, return second_cycle, return_leg and cycle_route when explicitly supported. Values must distinguish first meeting/first cycle from second meeting/return leg and preserve NULL when MLS scheduling is unbalanced or the source does not support the distinction. Do not assume every season is double round robin.

For each season, verify whether the competition was double round robin. Return a season-level record with season, value=true/false/unknown, definition, expected schedule rule, source_url, final_url, retrieved_at, field_locator and source_sha256. Only map the value to fixture rows when the season-level evidence and complete schedule support it; otherwise keep the row field unavailable.

Use high-recall football sources including the official MLS stats matches endpoint, MLS Fact and Record Book or official schedule pages, and cross-check with WorldFootball, Soccerway, FBref or another explicit schedule source. Preserve source conflicts instead of choosing silently. The official match_day is not a substitute for meeting_number.

Return row-level data even when a field is missing. Each row must include stable_match_key, season, date, home_team, away_team, field_name, value or NULL, status (ok/unavailable/blocked/conflict/parse_failed), source_url, final_url, retrieved_at, field_locator, source_sha256, field_semantics and evidence_notes. Include audit.expected, discovered, complete, partial, missing and unresolved_queue.

Only return football facts and provenance. Do not return or derive Qimen, nine-palace, palace relations, model direction, Miss labels, odds structures, probabilities, Outcome, Review, Gold or SQLite writes.
